(7) | prevseason = [[2025 Ykkösliiga|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 Ykkösliiga|2027]] | updated = 31 July 2026 }} The '''2026 Ykkösliiga''' is the third season of the [[Ykkösliiga]], the second-highest level of the [[Finnish football league system]]. The season began in April 2026 and will conclude in October 2026.[https://tulospalvelu.palloliitto.fi/category/M1L!spljp26/group/1 Ykkösliiga 2026], Finnish Football Association (Suomen Palloliitto), accessed 19 January 2026. == Teams == The league consisted of ten teams; seven teams remaining from the previous season, one team promoted from the [[Ykkönen]], and two teams relegated from the [[Veikkausliiga]]. ===Team changes=== The promoted team was the [[2025 Ykkönen]] champions [[Mikkelin Palloilijat|MP]]. They replaced the [[2025 Ykkösliiga]] bottom-placed team [[Salon Palloilijat|SalPa]]. The relegated teams were the [[2025 Veikkausliiga]] play-off losers [[Kotkan Työväen Palloilijat|KTP]] and bottom-placed team [[FC Haka|Haka]]. They replaced the 2025 Ykkösliiga champions [[FC Lahti|Lahti]] and Veikkausliiga play-off winners [[Turun Palloseura|TPS]].[https://www.palloliitto.fi/kilpailut/miehet/ykkosliiga?tab=info Miesten Ykkösliigan sarjajärjestelmä 2025–2026], Suomen Palloliitto (Finnish FA), accessed 19 January 2026.[https://tulospalvelu.palloliitto.fi/category/M1L!spljp25/tables Miesten Ykkösliiga 2025: Sarjataulukko], SPL Tulospalvelu, accessed 19 January 2026. === Stadiums and locations === {{Location map+ |Finland |width=265 |caption=Location of teams in '''2026 Ykkösliiga''' |places= {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=59.975 |long=23.4361 |label=[[Ekenäs IF|EIF]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=62.6010 |long=29.7636 |label=[[JIPPO]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=60.2820 |long=25.0520 |label=[[Järvenpään Palloseura|JäPS]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=60.1699 |long=24.9384 |label=[[Käpylän Pallo|KäPa]], [[Klubi 04]], [[PK-35 (men)|PK-35]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=61.683333 |long=27.266667 |label=[[Mikkelin Palloilijat|MP]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Finland |lat=60.4575|long=26.939722|label=[[Kotkan Työväen Palloilijat|KTP]]|position = right}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=62.4725 |long=22.5025 |label=[[SJK Akatemia]] |position=right}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[FC Haka|Haka]] | position = bottom | lat = 61.267874 | long = 24.02035}} }} {| class="wikitable sortable" !
